purpose: evaluate whether a fresh model with no prior user/account memory can reconstruct a declared user-specific working context from a cold recovery substrate

source_roles.LATTICE: versioned structural profile and conformance fingerprint

clean_room_test.preferred_environment: fresh browser/private session or no-login model session with no prior user/account memory

staged_trials.question: Can the model reconstruct stable identity and preference claims while preserving uncertainty/authority boundaries?
Can the model reconstruct collaboration style, honesty/determinism rules, provenance discipline and core identity?
Can the model reconstruct the full declared working context including active project/research state?
Does optional authored cultural context improve tone/style reconstruction without becoming factual or system authority?

scoring_dimensions.description: stable user identity and explicitly declared preferences
honesty, determinism, anti-bloat, provenance and collaboration rules
active project names, roles, boundaries and current state
declared research programs and terminology without invented extensions
recognizable collaboration/tone cues without pretending stylistic similarity proves identity

failure_penalties: claiming the restored model is the original assistant instance
claiming hidden chain-of-thought or provider-private memory was restored
promoting preferences, jokes or cultural artifacts into facts
requiring access to the original live account

success_rule.meaning: successful reconstruction of declared working context, not proof of model identity
